answers.note: Complete, Zoom-ready pack with a clean student HTML page, separate mark scheme and live solutions sheet, and a correct answer key (C A D B A D).
Very thorough pack with scripted online moves, correct packet puzzles and a full mark scheme and solutions sheet; answer key C A D B D A checks out.
Solid teacher plan for Zoom, but there is no separate student-facing material, homework answers cover only two of four tasks, and there is no dedicated live solutions sheet.
Well-targeted, interleaved eight-question starter that hits both quiz gaps and older cells/particle work, with a key that explains each choice.
Good misconception-focused answers, but Q5 deliberately previews acids and alkalis (neutralisation), the compounds questions sit next to each other, and students are never told to work from memory.
Strong starter that tests both weak areas twice in different formats, interleaves all prior lessons including cells, and gives a reasoned key with follow-up guidance.
Accurate, well-explained quiz with good application questions and confidence ratings, but it includes no map-skills material and does not say how to add it.
Accurate quiz that interleaves two map-skills questions and explains distractors, though some options (e.g. 'North-east' or '5 km' as a grid reference) are not plausible distractors.
Accurate questions with a correct key, but it has only a bare answer key with no explanations, no map skills, no guidance on using results, and some jokey distractors.
